title: Immunity and limitation on liability for emergency aeromedical services.
bodyText: The county shall not be liable for any claim of injury or death based on a failure to establish or continue emergency aeromedical services in any part of the county.
bodyHtml: [§46-198]  Immunity and limitation on liability for emergency aeromedical services.  The county shall not be liable for any claim of injury or death based on a failure to establish or continue emergency aeromedical services in any part of the county. [L 2021, c 208, pt of §1]
